corePassives.description: Upon releasing the Spiritual Pressure Burst technique, Ichigo enters the Spiritual Power Release state for 5s. During this time, basic attacks release sword waves instead of dealing direct damage. Each wave Penetrates all enemies in its path, dealing damage equal to 55% of ATK. (Each basic attack level increases Sword Wave DMG by 6%.)
corePassives.name: Spiritual Power Release

corePassives.description: While under the Spiritual Power Release state, Ichigo's basic attacks gain a(n) 25% increase in ASPD.
corePassives.name: Fierce Sword Waves

corePassives.description: While under the Spiritual Power Release state, has a(n) 50% chance to double the damage dealt by all sword waves.

rotations.name: Basic Combo
steps: Basic Attack until Max Spiritual Pressure

skills.description:
Ichigo wields Zangetsu and attacks the enemy 4 times with powerful Sword Pressure, dealing damage equal to 567.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. ~~Follow-up Attack~~ Tap basic attack immediately after releasing the Collapse Strike technique 
 Ichigo instantly performs a follow-up slash, dealing damage equal to 170% of ATK.
skills.name: Sword Pressure

skills.description:
Ichigo leaps toward the enemy and performs a swirling slash, dealing damage equal to 297.5% of ATK. He then launches the enemy into the air, dealing damage equal to 102.5% of ATK. During the attack, Ichigo accumulates Spiritual Pressure. ~~Spiritual Pressure Burst~~ Requires max Spiritual Pressure 
 Ichigo launches the enemy into the air, slams them into the ground, and releases all accumulated Spiritual Pressure upon their landing, dealing damage equal to 627.5% of ATK.
skills.name: Collapse Strike

skills.description: Ichigo condenses Spiritual Power into a crescent wave and releases it forward, penetrating all enemies in its path and dealing damage equal to 867.5% of ATK.
skills.name: Getsuga Tensho

skills.description: Ichigo impales an enemy with Zangetsu and wrenches it out, dealing DMG equal to 1352.5% of ATK and increasing their received Slash DMG by 20% for 8s.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step
